title: Travel expense policy
text: Employees may claim economy airfare for flights under six hours. Hotel costs are capped at 250 USD per night in tier-one cities. Receipts must be submitted within 30 days of travel through the expense portal.

title: Quarterly close checklist
text: The quarterly close starts five business days before quarter end. Accruals for GPU cloud usage must be booked by day three. Revenue recognition for multi-year AI platform contracts follows the ratable method.

title: Q3 revenue forecast (restricted)
text: The Q3 revenue forecast is 412 million USD, driven by AI Factory bookings in EMEA. The acquisition of Project Falcon is expected to close in November and is not public.

title: Chargeback model for AI infrastructure
text: GPU hours are charged back to business units at an internal rate per GPU hour. Storage on PowerScale is charged per terabyte-month of used capacity, measured from SmartQuotas reports. Idle reserved GPUs are charged to the reserving team.

title: Fine-tuning runbook
text: To fine-tune a model with LoRA, request a GPU node pool, mount the dataset PVC from PowerScale, and log every run to MLflow. Checkpoints are written to the checkpoints bucket on ObjectScale every 500 steps.

title: Dataset onboarding standard
text: Every dataset needs an owner, a classification, a licence and a retention period before it can be used for training. Datasets containing personal data must be approved by the privacy office.

title: RAG evaluation guide
text: Retrieval quality is measured with recall at k and mean reciprocal rank on a labelled question set. Answer faithfulness is checked with an LLM judge and human review of fifty samples per release.

title: Unreleased model benchmark (restricted)
text: The internal model Orion-2 scores 87 percent on the reasoning benchmark, beating the current production model by nine points. Release is planned after the safety review.

title: GPU node replacement procedure
text: Before replacing a PowerEdge XE GPU node, cordon and drain it in Kubernetes, put it in maintenance mode in OpenManage Enterprise, and collect a SupportAssist log through iDRAC.

title: Storage network design
text: The storage network uses dedicated 100 GbE or 400 GbE links with RoCE and priority flow control. NFS over RDMA and GPUDirect Storage traffic is isolated from the compute east-west fabric.

title: Ransomware response playbook
text: If ransomware is detected, isolate affected PowerScale access zones, lock the latest clean snapshot, and restore from the Cyber Recovery vault after CyberSense validates the copy.

title: Holiday calendar
text: The office is closed on public holidays. The change freeze for production AI platforms starts on December 20 and ends on January 3.
